name: vLLM_Benchmark_45_GPU_Choice
description: Study 45: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 (vLLM 0.29.0) on one or two GPU nodes that the optimizer picks per experiment among g5 (A10G), g6 (L4) and g6e (L40S), xlarge or 2xlarge, in us-east-2b: one node aggregated, two nodes aggregated behind a least-in-flight router, or P/D (node_a prefill -> node_b decode, NixlConnector over TCP). The workflow scales the chosen EKS node groups up and everything back to 0 after each experiment. Goal: router tokens/s per $/h of the nodes in use (aws_ec2_price), under TTFT/ITL p95 SLAs over 150 s (study 27's AIPerf ramp, 4096 in / 256 out). AWS pack 1.5.0, vLLM pack 1.14.0.

components.name: vllm_a
components.description: The vLLM pod on node_a (Deployment vllm-pd-mn-a, served name qwen3-8b-a): aggregated replica, or prefill in P/D. Carries the KV cache dtype shared by both pods.

components.name: node_b
components.description: The EC2 instance of node_b (family + size, AWS pack 1.5.0); aws_ec2_price is its on-demand $/h, exported by the router as pd_node_price_dollars_per_hour{node="b"}, 0 when node_b is not used.

components.name: pd_topology
components.description: The deployment seen from its router (Deployment vllm-pd-mn-router): topology, client-side TTFT/ITL/E2E, delivered tokens (model_name qwen3-8b-router). pod matches all pods, so active_gpus counts the vLLM pods in use.

components.name: vllm_b
components.description: The vLLM pod on node_b (Deployment vllm-pd-mn-b, served name qwen3-8b-b): aggregated replica, or decode in P/D. Not started when the topology uses one node.

components.name: node_a
components.description: The EC2 instance of node_a (family + size, AWS pack 1.5.0); aws_ec2_price is its on-demand $/h, exported by the router as pd_node_price_dollars_per_hour{node="a"}.

componentTypes.name: vLLM_PD_Topology
componentTypes.description: Prefill/decode disaggregated serving topology of a vLLM deployment (instance counts, KV connector, KV buffer), plus deployment-wide throughput and the client-side latency its router measures. Reference vLLM 0.29.0.

parameters.name: pd_prefill_instances
parameters.description: Number of dedicated prefill vLLM instances (kv_role kv_producer). 0 means no disaggregation: every instance serves whole requests (aggregated). Rendered by the study, not a vLLM flag.

parameters.name: pd_decode_instances
parameters.description: Number of decode vLLM instances (kv_role kv_consumer when pd_prefill_instances > 0, plain replicas otherwise). Rendered by the study, not a vLLM flag.

parameters.name: pd_kv_connector
parameters.description: kv_connector in --kv-transfer-config when disaggregated. NixlConnector = pull (decode reads from prefill), NixlPushConnector = push. Prefill and decode must use the same one. Ignored when pd_prefill_instances is 0.

parameters.name: pd_kv_buffer_device
parameters.description: kv_buffer_device in --kv-transfer-config: cuda transfers KV GPU to GPU, cpu stages it in registered host memory (not an automatic fallback). Ignored when pd_prefill_instances is 0.

componentTypes.name: vLLM
componentTypes.description: vLLM inference server (pack reference version vLLM 0.29.0)

parameters.name: scheduling_policy
parameters.description: Request scheduling policy. fcfs serves requests in arrival order; priority serves by priority value, with arrival time as tiebreaker. The default is fcfs.

parameters.name: tensor_parallel_size
parameters.description: Tensor parallelism degree. The default is 1 (no tensor parallelism).

parameters.name: enable_expert_parallel
parameters.description: Use expert parallelism instead of tensor parallelism to distribute MoE expert weights across GPUs. The default is false.

parameters.name: max_num_batched_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens processed per iteration. vLLM does not document a single fixed default; effective defaults range from 2048 to 16384 depending on hardware and usage mode. 2048 is used here as a common baseline.

parameters.name: prefill_schedule_interval
parameters.description: For data-parallel deployments (--prefill-schedule-interval), admits new prefills only every N engine steps, aligned across DP ranks, so prefill-heavy steps coalesce and the others stay decode-only. Requires vLLM 0.24.0+. The default is 1.

parameters.name: linear_backend
parameters.description: Linear layer (GEMM) kernel backend for the CUDA platform. If auto, vLLM auto-selects the first kernel supporting the current quantization scheme and GPU, which can pick a slow kernel on some hardware. The default is auto.

parameters.name: gpu_memory_utilization
parameters.description: Target GPU memory utilization, as a fraction of total GPU memory reserved for the model executor (weights, activations, and KV cache). The default is 0.92.

parameters.name: spec_tokens
parameters.description: Number of speculative tokens per step (--spec-tokens). 0 is an Akamas-only off sentinel: it must never reach vLLM (fails vLLM's own gt=0 check) and must be dropped whenever spec_method is none. Default: 0 (disabled).

parameters.name: data_parallel_size
parameters.description: Data parallelism degree. The default is 1 (no data parallelism).

parameters.name: performance_mode
parameters.description: Runtime performance preset. balanced is the default; interactivity favors low per-request latency at small batch sizes; throughput favors aggregate tokens/sec at high concurrency.

parameters.name: max_num_queued_reqs
parameters.description: Hard cap on in-flight requests, waiting plus running (--max-num-queued-reqs); above it new requests get HTTP 503. Requires vLLM 0.29.0+. 0 is an Akamas-only off sentinel that must never reach vLLM (drop the flag). The default is 0 (no limit).

parameters.name: max_model_len
parameters.description: Maximum model context length (prompt and output), in tokens. If unset, vLLM derives this automatically from the model's own config; 8192 is used here as a common baseline default.

parameters.name: attention_backend
parameters.description: Attention backend implementation for the CUDA platform. If auto, vLLM auto-selects the first backend supporting the current dtype/kv_cache_dtype/block_size, which can crash at startup on a bad pick. The default is auto.

parameters.name: enable_chunked_prefill
parameters.description: Enables chunked prefill (--enable-chunked-prefill), splitting prompts longer than the per-step token budget across engine steps so decodes never wait on a whole long prefill. Prerequisite for long_prefill_token_threshold. The default is true.

parameters.name: prefill_context_parallel_size
parameters.description: Prefill context parallel (PCP) group size (--prefill-context-parallel-size/-pcp). Multiplies with pipeline_parallel_size and tensor_parallel_size into vLLM's total world_size. The default is 1 (disabled).

parameters.name: spec_method
parameters.description: Speculative decoding method (--spec-method). "none" disables it: the study must omit --spec-method and --spec-tokens entirely, not pass a null-equivalent. "draft_model" additionally requires the study to render --spec-model itself. Default: none.

parameters.name: tokenizer_mode
parameters.description: Tokenizer implementation to use. The default is auto.

parameters.name: disable_cascade_attn
parameters.description: Disables cascade attention when true. The default is true (cascade attention disabled); set to false to let vLLM use it when its internal heuristic judges it beneficial.

parameters.name: optimization_level
parameters.description: Compilation aggressiveness level (CLI syntax -O<level>), trading startup time for runtime performance. The default is 2.

parameters.name: async_scheduling
parameters.description: Overlaps request scheduling with model execution to reduce per-step host overhead. Disabled by vLLM for some pooling/speculative-decoding/executor combinations. The default is true.

parameters.name: long_prefill_token_threshold
parameters.description: Per-request cap on prompt tokens scheduled per engine step under chunked prefill (--long-prefill-token-threshold): breaks head-of-line blocking by long prefills; must not exceed max_model_len. On vLLM <= 0.26 also classifies long prompts. Default 0 (off).

parameters.name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
parameters.description: Largest batch size for which a CUDA graph is captured. If unset, vLLM derives this from max_num_seqs (min(max_num_seqs * 2, 512)). 256 is used here as a common baseline default.

parameters.name: wna16_activation_dtype
parameters.description: Deployment-side switch, not a vLLM flag. Activation quantization of weight-only (WNA16) checkpoints on Marlin/Humming; fp8 or int8 sets VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE and VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG. Changes numerics. The default is auto (bf16).

parameters.name: decode_context_parallel_size
parameters.description: Decode context parallel (DCP) group size (--decode-context-parallel-size/-dcp). Reuses the tensor-parallel GPU group; tensor_parallel_size must be evenly divisible by this value. The default is 1 (disabled).

parameters.name: moe_backend
parameters.description: MoE expert kernel backend for the CUDA platform (MoE models only). If auto, vLLM picks the first backend supporting the quantization scheme and GPU. Valid values depend on the scheme. The default is auto.

parameters.name: compilation_mode
parameters.description: torch.compile compilation mode set via compilation-config (CompilationMode enum. 0 = NONE, no compilation; 1 = STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE; 2 = DYNAMO_TRACE_ONCE; 3 = VLLM_COMPILE, vLLM's custom Inductor backend). The default is 3.

parameters.name: kv_cache_dtype
parameters.description: Data type for KV cache storage. The default is auto, which uses the model's data type. fp8/fp8_e4m3/fp8_e5m2 enable KV cache quantization to reduce memory usage.

parameters.name: enforce_eager
parameters.description: Disables CUDA graph capture and always runs the model in eager PyTorch mode when true. The default is false (CUDA graphs enabled).

parameters.name: enable_prefix_caching
parameters.description: Enables automatic prefix caching (--enable-prefix-caching), reusing KV blocks of shared prompt prefixes across requests (multi-turn and agentic traffic). prefix_caching_hash_algo is a no-op when false. The default is true.

parameters.name: max_long_partial_prefills
parameters.description: For chunked prefill, the max number of long prompts (see long_prefill_token_threshold) prefilled concurrently; must be <= max_num_partial_prefills. Not in the reference vLLM 0.29.0 (removed in 0.28.0): drop the flag unless serving vLLM <= 0.26. Default 1.

parameters.name: block_size
parameters.description: KV cache block size, in tokens. Must be a multiple of 16 for every CUDA attention backend (FlashInfer supports only 16/32/64). The default is 16.

parameters.name: prefix_caching_hash_algo
parameters.description: Hashing algorithm used for prefix cache block hashing. The xxhash variants require the optional xxhash package to be installed. The default is sha256.

parameters.name: disable_custom_all_reduce
parameters.description: Disables vLLM's custom all-reduce kernel for multi-GPU tensor-parallel communication when true. Only relevant when tensor_parallel_size is greater than 1 on a single node. The default is false.

parameters.name: max_num_seqs
parameters.description: Maximum number of sequences per batch. 128 is vLLM's documented fallback default for testing; real-world defaults vary from 256 to 1024 depending on GPU and usage mode.

parameters.name: max_num_partial_prefills
parameters.description: For chunked prefill, the maximum number of sequences partially prefilled concurrently (--max-num-partial-prefills). Not in the reference vLLM 0.29.0 (removed in 0.28.0, last present in 0.26.x): drop the flag unless serving vLLM <= 0.26. Default 1.

parameters.name: pipeline_parallel_size
parameters.description: Pipeline parallelism degree. The default is 1 (no pipeline parallelism).

parameters.name: stream_interval
parameters.description: Streaming buffer size in tokens (--stream-interval). 1 sends every token as soon as it is generated; larger values batch tokens before sending, cutting host overhead at the cost of choppier streaming. The default is 1.

parameters.name: tuned_kernel_configs
parameters.description: Deployment-side switch, not a vLLM flag. If true, the study installs its tuned kernel configs (e.g. Triton FP8 block JSON) into the vLLM config folder before start. If false, vLLM uses its bundled configs. The default is false.

parameters.name: scheduler_reserve_full_isl
parameters.description: When true (--scheduler-reserve-full-isl), the scheduler admits a request only if its full input length fits in the KV cache, not just its first chunk, preventing over-admission and KV thrashing under chunked prefill. The default is true.

parameters.name: max_num_queued_tokens
parameters.description: Cap on total prompt tokens of requests still in prefill (--max-num-queued-tokens); above it new requests get HTTP 503 (TTFT QoS valve, about target TTFT x prefill throughput). Requires vLLM 0.29.0+. 0 is an Akamas-only off sentinel (drop the flag).

parameters.name: dtype
parameters.description: Data type used for model weights and activations. The default is auto, which selects float16 for float32/float16 models and bfloat16 for bfloat16 models.

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: Fraction of KV cache blocks kept free (--watermark) when admitting waiting or preempted requests, headroom against repeated eviction and preemption when GPU memory is scarce. Range [0, 1). Requires vLLM 0.24.0+. The default is 0.0 (off).
